title: Very nice shelf.
text: Very nice shelf.. This shelf is attractive and easy to assemble.  It feels sturdy and looks great at the same time. I don't think you'll be disappointed.  It doesn't take long to assemble. It is heavy, so you might want a little help with the pieces.

product_metadata.title: Flash Furniture Wynwood Collection Dark Ash Wood Grain Finish TV Stand with Shelves and Glass Frame
features: Come join us where minimalist design meets modern style in this visually engaging TV stand. Wood finish shelves tuck inside glass frames appearing to float adding to the sophistication and allure of this piece. The styling possibilities are endless!
Dark ash wood grain laminate finish, open storage compartments, supports up to 40" flat panel TV
Contemporary style fits nicely in your living room, family room, media room, man cave, or basement
PRODUCT MEASUREMENTS: Overall Size: 39.5"W x 17.75"D x 23"H; Height Between Shelves: 8"H
description: Take a little trip to sensational and elevate your entertaining space with this sharp looking TV Stand with Glass Frame. With the glass sided stand providing you with an uncluttered view, this brilliantly designed piece will steal the show in your home. Its modern open shelved structure with 8" of spacing allows you to display your game consoles, media players and cable boxes openly without infrared interference. Prominently display your 40" Flat Screen on this gorgeous stand that'll serve as an attraction piece on its own.
